description: This file is a shell script that provides setup functions, environment configurations, and utility methods for Git operations. It includes variable initializations, function definitions for handling repositories, error handling, and platform-specific tweaks.

methods.name: git_broken_path_fix
methods.description: Adjusts PATH to include a specified directory if not already included.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Terminates execution with an error message.

methods.name: die_with_status
methods.description: Exits with a specified status after printing a message.

methods.name: set_reflog_action
methods.description: Sets the GIT_REFLOG_ACTION variable if not already set.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Determines and executes the configured git editor.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Sets up the pager command for git output.

methods.name: is_bare_repository
methods.description: Checks if the current repository is a bare repository.

methods.name: cd_to_toplevel
methods.description: Changes directory to the top level of the Git repository.

methods.name: require_work_tree_exists
methods.description: Ensures that a working tree exists in the repository.

methods.name: require_work_tree
methods.description: Confirms the current directory is inside a working tree.

methods.name: require_clean_work_tree
methods.description: Verifies that the working tree is clean (no unstaged or uncommitted changes).

methods.name: pick_ident_script
methods.description: Generates a sed script to parse identity information from a commit.

methods.name: parse_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Feeds commit data through sed to extract identity info.

methods.name: get_author_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Retrieves author identity information from a commit.

methods.name: create_virtual_base
methods.description: Creates a virtual merge base for a two-file merge using git apply.

methods.name: git_dir_init
methods.description: Ensures current directory is within a valid Git directory.

methods.name: peel_committish
methods.description: Resolves a commit reference to its verified hash.
